description: This Dart source file provides analytics computations for quizzes in a Flutter application. It defines models for KPIs and per-quiz statistics, and provides providers for fetching quiz analytics data, including a singleton store for progress tracking and functions to compute analytics like total attempts, averages, and recent activity. It also includes a notifier class for refreshing analytics data.

classes.name: QuizKpis
classes.description: Model representing key performance indicators for quiz attempts, including totals, averages, best scores, and recent activity count.

classes.name: PerQuizStat
classes.description: Model representing statistics for an individual quiz, including attempts, scores, and completion status.

classes.name: QuizAnalytics
classes.description: Container for overall quiz KPIs and a list of per-quiz statistics.

methods.name: quizAnalyticsProvider
methods.description: Asynchronous provider that computes and returns comprehensive quiz analytics, including totals, averages, and recent activity.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Method to force refresh of the quiz analytics data by updating the notifier's state.
